endorsements.name: Atlan Pinabel
endorsements.label: Navigating the MTE Landscape: iOS Memory Protection Deep Dive
endorsements.description: Apple's deployment of **Memory Tagging Extension** (MTE) across iOS represents a fundamental shift in mobile platform memory safety. This talk provides a comprehensive technical analysis of how MTE is integrated throughout the iOS memory management stack, from kernel zone allocators to userland heap implementations. Read more
